title: join
body:
## join

Combines the evaluated geometry of two or more mesh nodes into one mesh in world coordinates (the result has an identity transform), keeping each face's material and smooth flag. It only gathers faces: overlapping parts remain separate intersecting shells, unlike a boolean UNION. Follow with weld to fuse touching seams or voxelRemesh to fuse overlaps into one surface.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- UV maps, vertex groups, custom attributes and custom normals are not preserved.
- The adaptor's recorded native qualification cases cover only a material on a cube; this operation relies on repository examples, not on a recorded qualification case.

Native binding: `join`. Output kind: `["data"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `inputs` | nonempty list | yes | `data` |

Options: none.
